sections.title: Range and form
sections.text: Jupunba obovalis, also treated as Abarema obovalis in taxonomic references, is a tree of the tropical forests of the Greater Antilles, including Cuba and Hispaniola. The sources consulted do not provide a reliable height.

sections.title: Leaves and flowers
sections.text: Its compound leaves bear leaflets with an obovate outline. Greenish flowers are grouped in globose heads, and the fruits are curved pods. The blue seed colour shown in the illustration is not confirmed by the sources consulted.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: No adequately supported food use or toxicity information was found for this species. Do not eat its seeds or pods based only on the illustration.
